correctness.rationale: Necessity of U and MP is immediate from universal Kripke successor semantics. For sufficiency, U puts all globally valid tautologies in each H_w, and MP yields finite conjunction closure. Finite W lets finitely many γ∈H_w define K_w=∩⟦γ⟧, hence θ∈H_w iff K_w⊂⟦θ⟧; the converse uses a globally true conjunction implication and detachment. Canonical R[w]=K_w preserves modal truth inductively. Every modal truth type T is formula-definable on finite W, so all representing rows consist exactly of nonempty chosen subsets of every type contained in K_w and no outside worlds; multiplying gives the stated census, with edge extrema #types and |K_w|. Independent 3-world 1+2 type sanity check gives 27, 3–6 edges.
residual_risks: All finite-world closure interpretations allowed; no equivalence with frame-global G is claimed.
Some checker routines sample four-world cases; numerical tests are not proof for arbitrary finite W.
